mapper.select: SELECT document_id FROM knowledge_feedback WHERE AND feedback_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM knowledge_candidate WHERE AND candidate_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_candidate WHERE AND feedback_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_candidate SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE AND candidate_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND revision < 2147483647
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint,receipt_json FROM knowledge_candidate_command WHERE AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT candidate_id,revision,document_id,job_id,created_at FROM knowledge_candidate_preparation WHERE AND candidate_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}

SELECT d.document_id,d.published_version AS version,d.published_generation AS index_generation,d.published_job_id AS job_id, j.processor_version,j.batch_digest,j.content_hash AS source_hash FROM knowledge_candidate_preparation p JOIN knowledge_candidate_revision r ON r.candidate_id=p.candidate_id AND r.revision=p.revision AND r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.document_id=p.document_id AND d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.owner_id=p.owner_id AND d.candidate_id=p.candidate_id AND d.candidate_revision=p.revision AND d.purpose='OPERATIONS_PREVIEW' JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.job_id=d.published_job_id AND j.document_id=d.document_id AND j.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND j.owner_id=d.owner_id AND j.document_version=d.published_version AND j.index_generation=d.published_generation WHERE p.tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND p.owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND p.candidate_id=#{id} AND p.revision=#{revision} AND d.lifecycle='ACTIVE' AND d.lifecycle_ready=TRUE AND j.status='READY' AND j.batch_digest IS NOT NULL AND j.content_hash=r.content_hash AND j.content_type=r.content_type AND j.size_bytes=r.size_bytes

SELECT candidate_id,revision,dataset_id,dataset_revision,created_at FROM knowledge_candidate_dataset WHERE AND candidate_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} ORDER BY created_at,dataset_id,dataset_revision LIMIT 11
SELECT candidate_id,revision,content_digest,run_id,manifest_digest,review_digest,publication_json,created_at FROM knowledge_candidate_evaluation WHERE AND candidate_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_candidate_evaluation (candidate_id,revision,tenant_id,owner_id,content_digest,run_id,manifest_digest,review_digest,publication_json,created_at) VALUES (#{row.candidateId},#{row.revision},#{caller.tenantId},#{caller.userId},#{row.contentDigest},#{row.runId},#{row.manifestDigest},#{row.reviewDigest},#{row.publicationJson},#{row.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_digest=#{row.contentDigest},run_id=#{row.runId},manifest_digest=#{row.manifestDigest}, review_digest=#{row.reviewDigest},publication_json=#{row.publicationJson},created_at=#{row.createdAt}
